title: DataSynth
summary: A full-stack platform (FastAPI backend, Next.js frontend, Celery workers) for generating synthetic tabular, text, and image datasets. Its tabular generator directly runs SDV's CTGANSynthesizer and TVAESynthesizer for data generation and SDV's evaluate_quality for metrics.
evidence: backend/app/generators/tabular_generator.py:52-58 uses SingleTableMetadata, CTGANSynthesizer, TVAESynthesizer, and evaluate_quality
